text:
anna (PM): thinking out loud — can we add a small quota-burn forecast widget to the route/model view? want teams to see 24h estimated token burn for a saved query or preset so they can tune batching/quantization before rollout

sam (Eng): curious — is this per-route only or per-saved-query (which may span routes)?

anna (PM): MVP = per-route + per-model toggle. saved-query attribution can come later. main goal: show estimated tokens and projected spend vs quota band\/commit

mira (Design): mockup ready — lightweight pill, 2 lines: "24h est tokens" and "% of quota". shows green/yellow/red. small tooltip with assumptions (avg seq len, rps). link: https://FPO/mock/quota-widget

julian (Analytics): for numbers we can surface a simple EWMA over last 6h rps * avg tokens per response. sample query (clicky):
```sql
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) / COUNT(request_id) AS avg_tokens, SUM(requests) AS last_6h_reqs
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY route;
```
we can return avg_tokens and recent_rps to compute 24h est on client

sam (Eng): that SQL is fine. question: do we compute in backend and store in telemetry index or compute on-demand in console? backend compute + cache seems better for scale

tasha (DevEx): prefer backend precompute as well — we can expose a small internal API: GET /internal/console/quota-forecast?route=...&model=...&preset=... that returns {avg_tokens, rps, projected_24h, confidence} (we should spec confidence)

anna (PM): +1 to internal API. also want that endpoint to accept a "policy_hint" param for routing policies (e.g., prefer-dedicated, fallback-to-small) so we can show alternative forecasts when rollouts use different routing

sam (Eng): minor debate: should the internal API return different projections for routing hints, or should console combine base metrics with routing-policy metadata client-side? My vote: server returns variants — easier for consistent UX and A/B

mira (Design): server-side variants are easier for visual parity across teams

julian (Analytics): we can compute variants by mapping policy -> expected model variant mix. need a small config table that maps policy to model weights, e.g., {prefer-dedicated: {m-large:0.8,m-small:0.2}}. that lives in infra-config service

sam (Eng): ok, adding that config means more infra work but fine. concern: churn when routing policies change often — we should include a "as-of" timestamp in the API response

ops-bot: deploy started: preview/quota-forecast-spike -> staging (sha: a5f2b3) :rocket:

anna (PM): acceptance criteria for spike: 1) /internal/console/quota-forecast returns projected_24h + confidence + variants for routing hints; 2) design mock integrated with per-route header; 3) telemetry query validated for 6h->24h extrapolation; 4) perf: API lat <200ms 95th on staging

tasha (DevEx): I'll own the endpoint and short doc for SDK usage. plan to add a small client helper in console SDK to normalize units (tokens -> $)

sam (Eng): i'll pair with tasha on the service. estimate 2-3 dev days for prototype + 1 day for telemetry QA

mira (Design): i'll hand off assets and color tokens for status. quick note: make tooltip editable so users can override avg seq len for more accurate projection

julian (Analytics): i'll run a backtest for 30 routes to produce confidence bands and share a csv by EOD

anna (PM): nice. follow-ups: decide persistence for "presets" — do we persist user-overrides as part of saved queries? prefer yes, but need auth scope. put it on next grooming

sam (Eng): quick API schema draft:
```json
GET /internal/console/quota-forecast?route=foo&model=gpt-xy&policy_hint=prefer-dedicated
-> {"route":"foo","model":"gpt-xy","as_of":"2026-03-19T14:00:00Z","projections":[{"policy":"prefer-dedicated","projected_24h":123456,"confidence":0.82}],"assumptions":{"avg_tokens":512,"rps":0.8}}
```

anna (PM): perfect. logging: capture which saved query id (if any) produced the call so we can tie forecast changes to query edits

tasha (DevEx): noted. i'll add saved_query_id and user_override to the query params. Also will add rate-limit of 10reqs/sec per-org to avoid noisy consoles hammering telemetry

mira (Design): small UX decision: if confidence < 0.5 show a "why low confidence" link that expands to a brief explanation (low sample volume, high variance).

anna (PM): agreed. last thing — let's surface an action button: "Simulate commit" which opens a modal to compare current quota vs projected commit bands (ui-only for spike). good to show PMs what commit tier they'd hit

sam (Eng): ok. putting a spike branch up today, will link staging once ops-bot finishes deploy

julian (Analytics): uploading the backtest now -> https://internal/csvs/quota-backtest-30routes.csv

anna (PM): thanks team — tagging this as spike/console-quota-forecast. will move to backlog->sprint if prototype looks good. :sparkles:
